title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: PMO - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender uma multinacional líder global no segmento de bens de consumo e transformação digital, com atuação em projetos estratégicos de tecnologia, inovação e expansão internacional.

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar em iniciativas globais e LATAM relacionadas à transformação digital, omnichannel, AI e implementação de sistemas corporativos , com forte interação entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar na gestão de projetos estratégicos e programas corporativos
  • Garantir acompanhamento de cronograma, escopo, riscos, custos e qualidade
  • Coordenar stakeholders locais e globais
  • Conduzir governança, status reports e fóruns executivos
  • Atuar na integração entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e implementação de sistemas
  • Garantir alinhamento entre times multidisciplinares
  • Atuar de forma hands-on na resolução de temas críticos e acompanhamento das entregas


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como PMO ou em gestão de projetos complexos

title: Especialista Azure AI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Azure AI em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Muito prazer, somos a United Hub Digital, uma consultoria de tecnologia nearshore que combina inovação, excelência técnica e agilidade para transformar negócios

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma das nossas marcas registradas. Atuamos com diferentes modelos e formatos de time, adaptando-nos ao contexto de cada cliente. Nosso diferencial está em entregar soluções de ponta com uma equipe enxuta, eficiente e com mentalidade de dono.


O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos desenvolvendo uma solução de extração inteligente de documentos para um cliente industrial, com foco em leitura automatizada de desenhos técnicos em PDF. A solução roda sobre Azure e Databricks, com modelos customizados treinados especificamente para o vocabulário técnico do cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Treinar modelos customizados no Azure Document Intelligence para diferentes categorias de desenho técnico;
  • Conduzir o processo de rotulagem de amostras em parceria com especialistas do cliente;
  • Integrar Azure OpenAI para tratar regiões não estruturadas que os modelos de extração não cobrem;
  • Definir estratégia de confiança, validação e fallback para os modelos treinados;
  • Orquestrar o fluxo de processamento com Databricks Jobs em conjunto com o time de dados;
  • Iterar sobre acurácia com base em feedback do cliente e métricas de validação;


O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Document Intelligence, incluindo treinamento de modelos customizados em produção;
  • Familiaridade com Azure OpenAI e integração de LLMs em pipelines de extração;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com documentos técnicos não estruturados e ambíguos;
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados no Azure (ADF, ADLS, ou Databricks);
  • Excelente comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Esta função pode gerar oportunidades de viagens domésticas e/ou internacionais;


Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota


Modalidade De Contratação

  • CLT ou PJ.

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET + React)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET + React) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir APIs RESTful utilizando .NET 8+ e ASP.NET Core, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e boas práticas de arquitetura
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento full stack, contribuindo também com frontend componentizado (React, Vue ou similares)
  • Construir e manter integrações com plataformas externas (e-commerce, marketplaces e parceiros logísticos), utilizando REST, GraphQL e OAuth 2.0
  • Implementar fluxos resilientes com uso de mensageria (ex: filas, retries, idempotência, circuit breaker)
  • Atuar de ponta a ponta (end-to-end), desde o design técnico até deploy em produção (Docker e ambientes cloud)
  • Investigar incidentes críticos, realizar troubleshooting avançado e atuar na causa raiz
  • Garantir observabilidade dos sistemas (APM, logs estruturados e métricas) para suporte à operação
  • Contribuir ativamente com decisões de arquitetura, avaliando trade-offs técnicos e impactos no negócio
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e integração) como parte do desenvolvimento
  • Participar de code reviews, promovendo qualidade, padrões e evolução técnica do time
  • Documentar APIs e fluxos técnicos (OpenAPI/Swagger, diagramas, changelogs)
Requisitos:
  • Forte experiência com .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento full stack (React, Vue ou similares).
  • Sólida experiência em design e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e modelagem de dados
  • Conhecimento prático em mensageria e sistemas assíncronos (ex: SQS, RabbitMQ ou similares)
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (xUnit, Moq ou similares)
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente AWS: S3, SQS, Lambda ou equivalentes)
  • Experiência com containers (Docker)
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, New Relic ou similares)
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e práticas de DevOps
  • Domínio de Git e estratégias de versionamento
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia
  • Visão crítica sobre arquitetura e qualidade de código
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e não técnicos
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas complexos
  • Ownership sobre o que desenvolve
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência aplicando IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex: copilots, code assistants, automação de testes, análise de logs)
  • Experiência com Kubernetes
  • Experiência com GraphQL
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura distribuída e microsserviços
  • Experiência com práticas como Clean Architecture, SOLID ou DDD
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta escala ou missão crítica
  • Sobre a vaga:
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Ambiente internacional.

title: SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients that is a leading healthcare company in the United States, focused on technology, operational resilience, and large-scale enterprise


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate disaster recovery (DR) testing activities across enterprise applications and services
  • Develop and execute structured DR test scenarios aligned with predefined recovery patterns
  • Produce detailed post-test reports, including outcomes, gaps, and recommendations for improvement
  • Track the build-out process of applications and services adhering to established DR strategies
  • Capture and manage corrective action plan (CAP) items in tools such as Fusion or ServiceNow
  • Support the adoption of automated and continuous testing practices for production systems
  • Maintain and manage scheduled (cadenced) DR testing cycles to ensure ongoing readiness
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on testing efficiency and DR process enhancements
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional DR team members and stakeholders
  • Facilitate coordination and execution of DR exercises to reduce risk and improve resilience
  • Support additional DR-related activities and initiatives as assigned by leadership


Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Disaster Recovery, IT resilience, or testing and validation processes
  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery concepts such as RTO, RPO, failover, and service restoration
  • Experience coordinating and executing testing activities in enterprise IT environments
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for tracking incidents and action items
  • Ability to analyze test results and produce clear, actionable reports
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing cycles and priorities
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with effective collaboration skills
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Problem-solving mindset with focus on risk reduction and process improvement


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• International team environment

title: Closer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Closer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga


Como Closer na Nutri de Consultório, você será responsável por conduzir as conversas finais com nutricionistas que já demonstraram interesse na Aceleração Nutri de Consultório (ANC), nosso treinamento principal para nutricionistas que querem estruturar e escalar seus consultórios. Sua missão é entender profundamente a realidade de cada candidata, apresentar a ANC como solução real para as dores dela e conduzir uma venda consultiva. Se você gosta de vender, tem habilidades em vendas de ticket alto e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está revolucionando a nutrição no Brasil, este é o seu lugar!


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões de venda consultiva por vídeo/call com leads qualificados pelo time de SDR
  • Realizar diagnósticos aprofundados das dores, objetivos e contexto de cada candidata antes de apresentar a ANC
  • Apresentar a ANC de forma personalizada, conectando os módulos do treinamento às necessidades reais do lead

  • Negociar condições de pagamento dentro das condições definidas pela empresa
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com status do lead, próximos passos, gravações e insights de cada conversa
  • Bater meta mensal de receita
  • Reportar os feedbacks e objeções recorrentes dos leads para alimentar marketing e produto
  • Acompanhar as suas métricas de desempenho e buscar evolução contínua


Competências

  • Experiência prévia comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas de ticket alto (a partir de R$ 3.000)
  • Domínio de técnicas de fechamento consultivo (SPIN Selling, quebra de objeções, ancoragem de valor, criação de urgência ética)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (calls) e escrita (follow-ups por WhatsApp e e-mail)
  • Inteligência emocional e resiliência para lidar com objeções e \"nãos\" sem desgaste
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas claras e ciclo de venda mais longo
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Postura consultiva — você ouve antes de falar, entende antes de oferecer
  • Diferencial: conhecimento ou interesse pelo mercado de nutrição ou educação.


Valores da Empresa

Os valores da empresa regem todos os atos de cada pessoa que faz parte da nossa equipe:

- Excelência na entrega

- Aprimoramento constante

- Foco na necessidade dos clientes

- Transparência


Localização: trabalho remoto.


Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.

  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Consultor SAP CO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP CO em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP CO Sênior com perfil estratégico e resiliente para atuar em um dos projetos mais desafiadores do mercado atual: a transição de um ambiente ECC altamente customizado para um template global em S/4HANA. O perfil ideal deve possuir vasta experiência em projetos de Rollout, com habilidade técnica para navegar em um landscape global complexo e sensibilidade de negócio para atuar na gestão de mudanças. Buscamos um profissional que saiba equilibrar as diretrizes de um template global com as necessidades críticas da localização Brasil, incluindo os impactos da reforma tributária, e que tenha autoridade técnica para guiar o cliente na jornada de volta ao padrão (Standard), reduzindo a dependência de customizações legadas.


Atribuições principais:

· Liderar o processo de implementação e adaptação do módulo CO dentro do Rollout S/4HANA, garantindo o alinhamento com o template global.

· Realizar o mapeamento de processos \"As-Is\" (ECC altamente customizado) e \"To-Be\" (S/4HANA Global Template), identificando gaps e propondo soluções.

· Configurar e suportar os sub-módulos de CO (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing e Profitability Analysis). ·

Atuar diretamente na localização Brasil, garantindo que as exigências fiscais e a nova reforma tributária sejam contempladas na arquitetura global.

· Colaborar com times globais em reuniões técnicas e de negócio, utilizando o inglês de forma fluente para apresentações e documentações.

· Validar e realizar testes integrados, além de suportar a fase de Go-live e Hypercare.

· Capacitar os usuários finais (Key Users) nas novas funcionalidades e processos do S/4HANA.


Requisitos:

· Sólida experiência como Consultor SAP CO (nível Sênior).

· Experiência comprovada em projetos de Rollout de S/4HANA.

· Domínio completo dos processos de Controladoria (CO-PC, CO-PA, CO-OM e Material Ledger).

· Conhecimento profundo em Localização Brasil (Tax e Requirements).

· Vivência em ambientes com landscape complexo e integrações globais.

· Capacidade de negociação técnica para lidar com a resistência à descontinuação de customizações (Z's).

· Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e de implementação SAP (Activate).


Diferenciais:

· Certificação oficial SAP S/4HANA.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require reading, analyzing, and synthesizing large document collections
  • Curate real-world research corpora — academic papers, case studies, technical reports — and design questions that require comprehensive analysis
  • Write structured ground-truth oracles (JSON) with specific, verifiable answers that prove the agent actually read the source material
  • Design LLM judge prompts that evaluate agent output field-by-field against the oracle
  • Create decomposition guides that split research across multiple parallel sub-agents (one per document, one per domain, then synthesis)


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of research experience (academic or industry) in any scientific domain
  • Strong reading comprehension with ability to extract structured data from unstructured text
  • Experience with JSON and data structures, including schema design and output validation
  • Proficiency in Python scripting for data processing and evaluation (e.g., judge scripts)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)
  • High attention to detail, especially for creating precise evaluation oracles without approximations


Nice to have:

  • Experience with systematic reviews, meta-analyses, or large-scale literature surveys
  • Familiarity with medical, legal, or scientific document analysis
  • Experience with NLP or information extraction tasks
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation and benchmarking (e.g., MMLU, GPQA, SimpleQA)
  • Experience curating datasets for AI evaluation


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments required: 40 hours /week with 4 hours of PST Overlap
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

title: Executive Assistant to Chief Executive Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant to Chief Executive Officer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Beige is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with our Founder & CEO across operations, investor relations, communications, partnerships, personal brand, and high-level business execution.

This is not a traditional assistant position. You will operate as an extension of the CEO and help manage the fast-moving day-to-day environment of a rapidly growing media technology startup.

If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, loves organization, thinks three steps ahead, and enjoys solving problems before they happen, we want to hear from you.

About Beige

Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale.

Through Beige.app, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform.

We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content.

As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth.

Location & Schedule
  • Location: Remote (International / Global Talent)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST
  • Note: Operational flexibility outside standard hours when necessary is a strong plus, as startup environments move quickly.
Compensation
  • Contract Rate: Starting at $1,000/month plus performance-based milestones and bonuses. Significant long-term growth opportunities are available for exceptional track-record execution.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Managing the CEO’s calendar, meetings, travel, scheduling, reminders, and priorities.
  • Acting as a gatekeeper and organizer for daily communication and inbound opportunities.
  • Following up on leads, partnerships, investors, advisors, clients, and strategic relationships.
  • Supporting investor relations efforts, fundraising outreach, and executive communications.
  • Helping manage aspects of the CEO’s personal brand, public presence, and social media activity.
  • Drafting emails, presentations, summaries, reports, meeting notes, and business communications.
  • Helping organize and execute projects across multiple departments while tracking deadlines.
  • Coordinating with team members, vendors, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Turning conversations into action items and ensuring execution actually happens.
  • Assisting with research projects and identifying business opportunities.
  • Acting as an extension of the CEO during meetings and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Who We're Looking For Required Qualifications:
  • Elite English Proficiency: 10/10 fluent written and spoken English with exceptional professional communication skills.
  • Previous experience directly supporting a Founder, CEO, Executive, or startup leadership team.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and execution skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision and high autonomy.
  • Extremely proactive mindset—you naturally identify and solve problems before they escalate.
  • Strong executive presence, professional judgment, and absolute discretion.
  • High emotional intelligence; comfortable communicating with high-profile individuals and personalities.
  • High adaptability and a calm demeanor when priorities shift quickly in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred / Major Plus:
  • Deep experience within media, content production, technology, entertainment, creator economy, or startup ecosystems.
  • Prior exposure to investor relations, fundraising workflows, or capital raises.
  • Basic graphic design experience (Canva, Adobe, Figma) for creating presentations and marketing assets.
  • Social media management or personal brand building experience.
  • CRM fluency (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Advanced proficiency using AI tools (ChatGPT, automation platforms) and modern productivity suites (Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Notion).
Core Behavioral Expectations:

To succeed in this role, you must thrive on high-speed execution, welcome rapidly shifting priorities, and actively prefer dynamic problem-solving over highly repetitive, predictable administrative tasks.

How to Apply

We are moving fast to fill this position. If you are ready to operate at an elite executive level, please submit:

  • Your Resume
  • A short introduction video (2–3 minutes) detailing:
  • Your specific experience supporting founders, CEOs, or fast-growing startups.
  • Why you are a perfect fit for the culture at Beige.
  • Your favorite productivity and AI tools that you currently use to optimize your workflow.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science (e.g., competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research)
  • Strong Python programming skills, including NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy)
  • Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers (not subjective or open-ended)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Comfortable with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)
  • Understanding of numerical methods, including floating-point tolerance, convergence criteria, and error bounds


Nice to have:

  • Experience creating math competition problems (e.g., AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar)
  • Research experience in mathematics, theoretical computer science, or quantitative fields
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI)
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments required: 40 hours /week with 4 hours of PST Overlap
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month; (expected start date is next week)

title: Consultor SAP SD/OTC
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP SD/OTC em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Analisar requisitos de negócio e desenhar soluções OTC dentro do SAP (módulos SD/FI e integrações relacionadas).
  • Configurar e manter funcionalidades SAP Order-to-Cash, incluindo:
  • Order Management
  • Pricing
  • Billing & Invoicing
  • Credit Management
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Finanças, Logística e Procurement para garantir alinhamento de processos.
  • Atuar no suporte ao sistema, troubleshooting e implementação de melhorias.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais e coordenar demandas junto aos times técnicos.
  • Realizar testes, treinamentos e documentação para usuários finais.
  • Atuar em atividades de go-live e hypercare durante rollouts SAP.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (daily meetings, sprint planning, retrospectives) e entregar soluções de forma iterativa.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua e automação de processos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Sistemas de Informação, Administração, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP Order-to-Cash (OTC).
  • Vivência com configuração e suporte SAP OTC.
  • Conhecimento das integrações entre módulos OTC e FI/MM.
  • Forte entendimento dos processos SAP SD e estruturas de dados.
  • Capacidade de realizar debug básico em ABAP e interação com equipes técnicas.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe ou similares).
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (obrigatório).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SAP ECC.
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Certificação SAP nos módulos SD ou OTC.
  • Conhecimento em EDI, processamento de IDoc e integrações com sistemas terceiros.
  • Vivência em projetos de melhorias contínuas e automação de processos.


Competências comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação e interação com diferentes áreas de negócio.
  • Perfil colaborativo para atuação em times multidisciplinares.
  • Organização e autonomia na condução das atividades.
  • Facilidade para adaptação e aprendizado contínuo.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

description:

We're hiring CSMs who own marketplace revenue, not feature adoption.


R$130,000 to R$150,000 | Remote | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our growing team.


Your Mission

  • Running Onboarding That Sticks: New customers land every week. You own the mechanics. Kickoff calls, technical setup, training sessions, the first thirty days.
  • Contributing to the CSM Strategy: You build the assets that make the strategic plays scale. Sales enablement decks, marketing playbooks, reseller activation kits. Content that lands across Sales, Marketing, and Partnership.
  • Driving Adoption to First Sale: Map the stakeholders. Surface the blockers. Get the customer to their first marketplace sale on best practices.
  • Adoption & change management: driving usage and behavior change inside a customer org, especially when the champion who signed isn't the end user who has to adopt.


What We're Looking For

  • +1 year in customer success, account management, sales development, or a customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or agency CS experience does not transfer.
  • English and Portuguese fluent. You present to Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Finanças, Logística e Procurement para garantir alinhamento de processos.
